text: Celsius Holdings, Inc. is a US listed company; its 2026 proxy statement's table of 5% beneficial owners lists Chau Hoi Shuen Solina (8.97%), Alani Holdings, LLC (8.74%, attributed to Max Clemons and Trey Steiger), AllianceBernstein L.P. (6.27%) and BlackRock, Inc. (5.64%).
short: Celsius Holdings is a listed company; largest 5% holders are private investors and asset managers.
